title: Murder
punishment: Death or imprisonment for life, and fine
elements: Act causing death of human being
Done with intention of causing death or bodily injury likely to cause death
Absence of exceptions (grave provocation, self-defense, sudden fight)

title: Murder by Mob / Lynching (Five or more persons)
punishment: Death or imprisonment for life, and fine
elements: Five or more persons acting in concert
Murder committed on grounds of race, caste, community, sex, place of birth, or religion

title: Culpable Homicide not amounting to Murder
punishment: Imprisonment for life or up to 10 years, and fine
elements: Causing death without premeditated intent
Under sudden fight or provocation without undue advantage

title: Causing Death by Rash or Negligent Act
punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years and fine
elements: Act performed without criminal intent
Rashness or gross negligence resulting directly in death

title: Hit and Run (Causing Death and Escaping without Reporting)
punishment: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine
elements: Causing death by rash or negligent driving
Escaping from the spot without reporting to police officer or magistrate soon after the incident

title: Voluntarily Causing Hurt
punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year or fine up to ₹1,000 or both
elements: Bodily pain, disease, or infirmity caused to any person
Act done with intention or knowledge of causing hurt

title: Voluntarily Causing Grievous Hurt
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine
elements: Emasculation, loss of sight, hearing, limb/joint, bone fracture or tooth dislocation
Severe bodily pain for 20+ days

title: Kidnapping
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine
elements: Taking or enticing any minor or person of unsound mind out of lawful guardianship
Without consent of guardian

title: Theft
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both (Community service for petty theft under ₹5,000 on first offense)
elements: Dishonest intention to take movable property
Out of possession of any person without consent
Moving of property in order to effect taking

title: Robbery
punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine; highway robbery up to 14 years
elements: Theft or extortion accomplished by causing or attempting to cause death, hurt, or wrongful restraint
Fear of instant death or hurt

title: Criminal Breach of Trust
punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years or fine or both
elements: Entrustment of property or dominion over property
Dishonest misappropriation or conversion to own use
Violation of legal direction or contract

title: Cheating and Dishonestly Inducing Delivery of Property
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine
elements: Deception of any person fraudulently or dishonestly
Inducing person to deliver property or make/alter valuable security
Fraudulent intent existing from inception

title: Forgery for Purpose of Cheating
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine
elements: Making false document or electronic record
Intention that document forged shall be used for cheating

title: Criminal Intimidation
punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both; up to 7 years if threat of death/grievous hurt
elements: Threatening injury to person, reputation, or property
Intent to cause alarm or force unlawful act

title: Defamation
triable_by: Court of Session (if constitutional dignitary) or Magistrate
punishment: Simple imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both or community service
elements: Making or publishing imputation concerning any person
Intending to harm or knowing it will harm reputation
Without falling in 10 statutory exceptions (truth for public good, fair comment)

title: Criminal Conspiracy
punishment: Treated same as abetment of offense
elements: Agreement between two or more persons
To commit an illegal act or act done by illegal means

title: Organized Crime (Syndicates, Extortion, Land Grabbing)
punishment: Death or life imprisonment if death caused; minimum 5 years up to life, fine >= ₹5,00,000
elements: Continuing unlawful activity by member of crime syndicate
Use of violence, threat of violence, intimidation, or coercion
To obtain direct or indirect material benefit

title: Act Endangering Sovereignty, Unity and Integrity of India
punishment: Imprisonment for life or up to 7 years, and fine
elements: Purposely exciting or attempting to excite secession or armed rebellion
Subversive activities endangering sovereignty or unity of India
Distinguished from peaceful constitutional dissent
